description: This file defines a class 'LessThanOrEqual' which extends 'AbstractRule', used for validation purposes within the OrangeHRM project. It checks if a given input is less than or equal to a specified target object, which can be a closure, DateTime, float, or int.

classes.name: LessThanOrEqual
classes.description: A validation rule to check if input is less than or equal to a target value, which can be dynamically obtained via a callable, or a DateTime, float, or int.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with a target object which can be a Closure, DateTime, float, or int.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the input value is less than or equal to the target object, handling callables and DateTime objects appropriately.
